Nothing on this page has to be trusted. From the repository, three commands check era-0-1 in tiers; the repository is not public yet, and these are the commands it will carry.

make verify ERA=era-0-1 TIER=1   # the chain, the Merkle root, the head
make verify ERA=era-0-1 TIER=2   # every birth re-derived, every life re-run, no model
make verify ERA=era-0-1 TIER=3   # every answer asked of the model again, on the GPU class

Hall IV · The timeline

When each part of the record was fixed.

Each block number is the first Bitcoin block that attests the document's hash, read from its OpenTimestamps proof: the document existed, exactly as it is now, no later than that block. A protocol's block comes before its era's first; a replay carries its date.

  1. block 972,735
    genesis

    Genesis

    PM-0, written by hand, lives for the first time. Superseded: replay found the host's inode numbers reaching the organism.

    strata/genesis.head.json
  2. block 972,778
    genesis

    Genesis, again

    Superseded: an engine that had compiled the interpreter charged more fuel at every start.

    strata/genesis-2.head.json
  3. block 972,779
    genesis

    Genesis, current

    The world replays exactly, in place and from a fresh folder with no compiled cache.

    strata/genesis-3.head.json
  4. blocks 972,789 to 972,792
    mutagen

    The mutagen

    A pinned open-weights model writes a hundred children of PM-0, deterministic to the byte. No heredity, no selection: it tests the machinery.

    strata/mutagen.rules.mdstrata/mutagen.head.json
  5. blocks 972,812 to 972,814
    era 0

    Era 0 is frozen

    Its hypotheses, thresholds and spend cap, and the blind rules' card, before the pilot's first birth.

    protocol/era-0.mdstrata/era-0.rules.md
  6. block 972,822
    era 0

    Amendment 1

    The model moves to one class of rented GPUs whose machines answer the same requests byte for byte, before any data it affects.

    protocol/era-0.amendment-1.md
  7. blocks 972,833 to 972,838
    era 0

    Era 0's pilot and ten runs

    Three arms from PM-0, a hundred generations each.

    era 0

    H1 to H4 run once, as the protocol fixes them. Every run replayed, and one again away from home.

    strata/era-0.replay-2026-10-23.json

The judge is calibrated against cert-machine's exact decision of EinsteinArena solution 542 (§5). The record chain and the run governor are ported from cert-machine. Clade Code is published at carlostoledo.co, the home of cert-machine.

Words kept off these pages: understands, thinks, knows, PhD-level, smarter than, AGI, journey toward, path to, progress toward, higher organism, lower organism, evolves into, evolve into, goal of evolution, meant to. Each names an inner state or a credential no test certifies, or gives evolution a direction it does not have. Machina sapiens, habilis and erecta are the names of tests, never destinations.
